card.name: Word just before a 'but' or 'however' turn
card.fires_on: Words in label text that end a clause and set up a contrast or condition, such as 'resolved' after 'If', 'results' after 'negative', or 'will' after 'most children'. The same word often comes right before a comma, 'within', or 'however'.

modes.label: Resolution conditions
modes.description: 'resolved' after 'If' or 'until' in dose-hold and resume instructions.
modes.example: If<< resolved>> within 6 weeks, resume JIDE

modes.label: Negative findings
modes.description: Words like 'results', 'observed' or 'in' after a negation in study summaries.
modes.example: paradoxical bronchospasm was not<< observed>>. However, paradoxical bronchosp

modes.label: Partway through medical terms
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of long medical words such as hypersensitivity or discontinuation.

card.plain: It fires on words that finish a statement about a condition or a negative finding, just before the text moves on to a contrast or next step.
